none: PAS CAM-D6710C: Three Late Early-Medieval Coins : Hoard of three silver coins, two of Burgred, king of Mercia, and one of Aethelred I, King of Wessex
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ BVRGRED REX ; R/ MON/+DVDDA/ETA ; R/ MON/ADVLF/ETA ; D/ +AEDELRED/REX ; R/ MON/MANNIN:/ETA

Three silver Early-Medieval coins. - A three line Lunette 'type B' coin of Burgred, King of Mercia, AD 852-874. North number 424. Obverse shows a diademed bust right, the body breaking through the area of legend. Obverse legend reads BVRGRED REX. Reverse shows a three line Lunette, type B. Reverse inscription reads MON/+DVDDA/ETA. Moneyer is Dudda. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.38g, diameter…
